title.native: 城下町のダンデライオン

description:
In the story, the everyday lives of the nine super-powered siblings of the royal family are monitored by more than 200 surveillance cameras and broadcast nationwide. The people of the nation who are watching the broadcast will have the ability to elect the next monarch. The story focuses on Akane, the third-oldest sister who can manipulate gravity. She is shy and desperately does not want to be caught on camera.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description:
__Ability:__ Gravity Core

The main viewpoint character, Akane is the third daughter and fourth child of the Sakurada family. She hates being the center of attention and being followed by cameras all day. Her ability is Gravity Core, which allows her to manipulate the gravity of herself and anyone she touches, as well as allowing her to increase her speed and strength.

__Ability:__ Heaven's Gate

Kanade is the third of the nine Sakurada children and the second oldest daughter. She is twins with her brother [Shuu](https://anilist.co/character/89193/Sakurada-Shuu). She is also the vice president of the student council.

Her ability makes her able to materialize any object. However, the cost of the object is immediately removed from her savings.

__Ability:__ God Hand

Hikari is the seventh of the nine Sakurada children and the second youngest daughter.

She later becomes an idol under the name Light Sakuraba and using her ability to make herself look older. She does that in an attempt to become more popular after getting inspired by another young idol, Sachiko.
She doesn't seem to be very interested in becoming king, and instead focuses on her idol career.

Her ability makes her able to change the growth state of any living being for 24 hours.

__Ability:__ Transporter

Shuu is the second of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest son. He is twins with his sister [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/89099/Sakurada-Kanade).

His ability makes him able to teleport him and anyone he touches to a certain location.

Without realizing it, he has a crush on his childhood friend, [Hana Satou](https://anilist.co/character/241563/Satou-Hana). He ends up dating her, and she helps him with his campaigning program for the elections.

__Abilities:__ Invisible Work, Absolute Order

Aoi is the first of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest daughter.

~!She decides to withdraw from the elections as her true power which was kept secret from everyone was Absolute Order which makes people to follow her orders even though it's against their will.!~

__Ability:__ All for One

Misaki is the fifth of the nine Sakurada children and the third youngest daughter. She is twins with her brother [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/89217/Sakurada-Haruka). It is heavily hinted she has a crush on Haruka.

Her ability makes her able to duplicate herself up to 7 clones of herself. Each clone represents one of the 7 deadly sins. Since each copy excels in each of their aspects, Misaki gets annoyed that that makes her look bland in comparison as she doesn't excel in anything.

__Ability:__ Soulmate

Shiori is the last of the nine Sakurada children and the youngest daughter. Despite being very young, she's actually thoughtful and observant. She particularly cares for [Teru](https://anilist.co/character/89214/Sakurada-Teru) and [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/89218/Sakurada-Aoi). She sometimes helps Teru during his speeches.

Her ability makes her able to communicate telepathically with animals and objects.

Hana is Shuu's classmate from elementary school who moved out from the town. After coming back to the town for high school, she falls in love with him.

~!After confessing her feelings to him publicly, Shuu accepts her feelings, but decides to put a status quo on their relationship since he wants to focus on the election, though they end up properly dating. She helps him a lot by managing his campaign speeches and schedule.!~

__Ability:__ Lots of Next

Haruka is the sixth of the nine Sakurada children and the middle son. He is twins with his sister [Misaki](https://anilist.co/character/89216/Sakurada-Misaki). He tends to be the straight man in the antics of his siblings and remains calm. He is not interested in becoming king, and instead supports Misaki by helping her in her campaign. It is slightly hinted he may have feelings for Misaki.

His ability makes him able to calculate the probabilities of any situation.
Souichirou is the father of the nine Sakurada children and the king. His ability is reading the aura of emotions from people.
Satsuki is the mother of the nine Sakurada children and the queen.

__Ability:__ Limit Over

Teru is the eighth of the nine Sakurada children and the youngest son. He is the most enthusiastic of the siblings. He tends to speak in an old fashioned way and likes to think of himself as a hero. He also likes to impress his younger sister, [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/89215/Sakurada-Shiori).

His ability makes him able to drastically increase his body strength to a superhuman level.
